Name: Spiky Shield
Effect: Reaction 3. Shield Move. Reduce 3 Damage this Pokémon would receive from a Damaging Move. If the Target used a non-Ranged Physical Move. Roll 2 Dice of Typeless Damage against it, ignore defenses.
Description: The Pokémon bunkers themselves inside a shield of thorned brambles sprouting from the ground. Anyone who gets too close will get tangled in the spiky vines.
